steps.name: AGENDA
questions: Objective: understand your virtual estate (15-20 min). Last 10 min: decide a next step or part ways. Does that feel fair?

steps.name: PAIN
questions: What did the reseller say that made you agree to the meeting?
You mentioned [her words]. What does that affect over the next 6 to 12 months?
What's driving [her word] to be a priority?
Is this the thing to focus on, or will something overpower it?
steps.feeds: Her pain, What it affects, Why it's a problem

steps.name: SITUATION
questions: Walk me through your estate: what runs on it, how many hosts and VMs, how much storage, how big is the team?

steps.name: NUMBER
questions: You said [her words]. Roughly how much has it gone up by? 10%, 50%, or more?
Can you put a monetary value on it?
What does she pay now per year?
What is the quote she has seen (per year)?
What can she absorb without cutting anything (per year)?
When is the deadline for this?
What is the renewal date?
What happens if nothing changes by then?

steps.name: CAUSE
questions: Why do you think this is going to hit you so hard?
To what extent is [her cause] an issue for YOU?
What else is driving this to matter right now?

steps.name: IMPACT
questions: What ripple effect is this having on other people? Who else feels this, and why is it a concern to them?
How does this affect you personally?
Who else needs to sign off on this?
What would they need to see?
Where would the money for this come from? Is it set aside, or does it need requesting?
steps.feeds: Buying box, Y's for the pitch

steps.name: OUTCOME
questions: What do you need to happen before [her date]?
Which of those matters most to you?
Why does that matter to you personally?

steps.name: CLOSE
questions: We said we'd decide if a next step makes sense. Does it?
What do you need from us beforehand?
Who else should be in the room?
Let's book a working session, worked back from your deadline.
